Quick answer

What is revenue leakage? Revenue leakage is money a business has earned but does not collect, because its records disagree. An order is delivered and never invoiced. An invoice does not match its order. A price drifts from the contract.

How does AI detect it? It reconciles the records continuously, usually as a three-way match of order, delivery and invoice, and flags every mismatch with its evidence. Zonar OS™ does this, and HALU™ turns the verified findings into briefings. A human approves what happens next.

Where leakage hides

It happens between systems,
not inside them.

Your ERP, CRM and billing tools each look correct on their own. Leakage lives in the gaps between what was sold, contracted, delivered, billed and paid.

🤝

Sold vs contracted

Discounts and terms that were not in the agreement.

🚚

Contracted vs delivered

Goods or services delivered that the contract did not cover.

🧾

Delivered vs billed

Work delivered and never invoiced, or invoiced for the wrong amount.

💳

Billed vs paid

Invoices outstanding, short-paid or paid with no invoice behind them.

FAQ

Revenue leakage detection: common questions.

What is revenue leakage?+
Revenue leakage is revenue a business has earned but does not collect, because its records disagree. Common examples are orders delivered and never invoiced, invoices that do not match their orders, and prices that drift from the contract.
What causes revenue leakage?+
Most leakage comes from gaps between systems and teams: manual handoffs between operations and finance, pricing and discount errors, partial billing, and invoicing done outside the order system.
What is a three-way match?+
A three-way match compares an order, a delivery record and an invoice for the same transaction. If any of the three disagrees, it is flagged as a finding with the source rows that show why.
Can AI detect revenue leakage?+
Yes. AI can reconcile records continuously and surface mismatches far faster than manual review. Zonar OS pairs a deterministic reconciliation engine with an LLM layer that explains the verified findings, so results are repeatable and traceable.
Is a human in the loop?+
Yes. HALU drafts, flags and escalates. Your team approves every action that matters, and every run, read and decision is logged.
How is this different from reconciliation or revenue assurance software?+
Financial close tools typically focus on account reconciliation inside finance, and revenue assurance tools on billing and contract data. Zonar OS verifies the operational trail from order to delivery to invoice across departments, and HALU briefs the owner of each gap. It is deployed for you by the Neural Horizons AI team in the UAE and GCC.
Does it replace our ERP or CRM?+
No. It sits on top of your systems and works from the data they already produce, today through file exports.
How do I estimate how much I am losing?+
Use the free Revenue Leak Calculator for an instant estimate, then talk to us about a Reconciliation Audit on your own files for the real number.
